title: Placebo Neuroepo multisession Phase II and III
description: A randomized, placebo-controlled clinical trial investigating the neuroprotective and neuromodulatory effects of intranasal NeuroEPO (erythropoietin) in Parkinson's disease patients. The study combines clinical assessments using the MDS-UPDRS III scale with EEG recordings at baseline and 9-month post-intervention timepoints to evaluate whether NeuroEPO-induced changes in brain function, as measured by EEG source activity, mediate cognitive and motor outcomes. This multisession Phase II/III dataset provides evidence for EPO's role in synaptic plasticity and dopaminergic system resilience.
methods_description: Participants were enrolled in a randomized, placebo-controlled design with NeuroEPO administered intranasally according to protocol (Cuban Public Registry RPCEC00000233-En) or placebo. Clinical and EEG assessments were conducted at baseline (pre-intervention) and 9 months post-intervention. Motor severity was assessed by certified neurologists using MDS-UPDRS III item scores. Cumulative treatment exposure was quantified as total NeuroEPO dose.
